description: Genesis 10:19 is held and the request lists the Sodom and Gomorrah map of Bible Mapper first and two Logos rows after it (the Logos Atlas at the verse's places and the Lexham Geographic Commentary, each titled '(opens in Logos)'); asked 'can I see this in the Logos atlas?', the answer names the Logos Atlas and carries one map link, to the Logos Atlas row (id places), not to Bible Mapper's map.

request.greek: וַֽיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִצִּידֹ֔ן בֹּאֲכָ֥ה גְרָ֖רָה עַד־ עַזָּ֑ה בֹּאֲכָ֞ה סְדֹ֧מָה וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאַדְמָ֥ה וּצְבֹיִ֖ם עַד־ לָֽשַׁע׃
request.english: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
